title: Recommended Vacuums for Cleaning Baseboards

content.html:
Even though you see them every day, it's likely that you only notice baseboards when they're filthy. Baseboards may be found on practically every wall in your house, in nearly every room, so finding a reliable vacuum that can clean them is helpful. 

The best vacuum for cleaning baseboards is the Dyson Big Ball Animal 2. Its trademark, cylinder shape makes for easy maneuvering, even in corners, and powerful suction ensures a thorough clean. Plus, it has effective attachments to help clean baseboards, all with minimal effort on your part.

The instances in which I wouldn't recommend the Dyson Big Ball Animal 2 are when:

  • You need a cordless or lightweight vacuum. Go with the Shark IZ363HT Anti-Allergen Pet Power Cordless Stick Vacuum.
  • You prefer a handheld vacuum. Go with the Black & Decker Cordless Lithium Hand Vacuum.

In this article, I'll share why these are some of the best vacuums on the market for cleaning baseboards. I" ll also cover the features to consider before purchasing a new vacuum to help you find one that's best for you.

3 Best Vacuums for Baseboards

You can't clean baseboards with just any vacuum, as that isn't the primary purpose of a vacuum cleaner. Rather, you need some type of special equipment, be it a unique attachment or premium vacuum, to properly clean baseboards. Indeed, some vacuums are better than others at this task. 

Below are 3 of the best vacuums for cleaning baseboards to consider. (All are available on Amazon.com)

Dyson Big Ball Animal 2

The Dyson Big Ball Animal 2 vacuum cleaner is one the finest you can get for a big home, particularly if you have a few pets. Thanks to its innovative brush heads, the motorized brush bar removes tough dirt from muddy stains, which don't get caught up. 

Dyson's cylinder type is a popular choice for those who seek a rapid yet thorough clean, thanks to its powerful suction. As a result, the pneumatic cleaner head provides the most efficient clean we have ever seen. 

Our evaluation discovered that the simple setting was more than sufficient, and in fact, the suction was so strong that it required a little more effort to push over carpets. You can't complain too much about the added work since the carpets came out looking like we had never cleaned them before. 

Features for Cleaning Baseboards

With a wide variety of attachments, cleaning stairs, furniture, and baseboards is a breeze. All kinds of fluff and debris are picked up by rotating heads, including a turbine head for finer dust on hard floors. The wide hose makes it easier to get into all corners of the room. 

With the help of Dyson's trademark ball, this vacuum is very simple to maneuver. Especially while it isn't the lightest, its small shape makes it easy to carry, even up and downstairs, and clean baseboards, where cylinder vacuums may be challenging to maneuver. 

Shark IZ363HT Anti-Allergen Pet Power Cordless Stick Vacuum

This incredible vacuum from Shark claims to offer all the power of a corded vacuum, but in a cordless device.

When tested on a pet hair-filled floor, the Shark IZ363HT Anti-Allergen Pet Power Cordless Stick Vacuum left a noticeable line of a brilliant cream carpet after just one pass. In normal mode, this is great, and boost mode is much more astounding. Plus, it works just as effectively on wood floors and other hard surfaces.

Features for Cleaning Baseboards

A removable battery pulls out to plug into an external charger, and it lifts away to clean the stairs and upholstery without a stick. This is a great feature, especially for cleaning baseboards, not to mention corners. 

In addition, the vacuum is easily switched between carpet and hard surfaces without swapping attachments using the LCD control pad on the vacuum handle. This lowers the brush to work on hard floors and protects your baseboards from scratching. Plus, it has an extension attachment for easier accessibility into the tight spaces between your furniture and the wall.

Black & Decker Cordless Lithium Hand Vacuum

If you'd rather have a vacuum to dedicate to cleaning your baseboards, consider this cordless handheld dustbuster from Black & Decker. With a 16 AW cyclonic action that's supported by a 10.8 Volt power rating, this vacuum is tiny but mighty. The incredible suction power remains strong while removing debris from even the smallest spaces in your home.

Features for Cleaning Baseboards

This powerful handheld vacuum has a slim nozzle to better target dust and dirt in hard-to-reach areas behind furniture or in corners. Plus, it comes with an extendable crevice attachment tool, so you won't have to bend over as much and strain to reach your baseboards.

Not to mention, this vacuum is cordless, which means you won't have to stop every so often to unplug and replug the vacuum in a new outlet. This makes it easy to keep a continuous flow throughout the entire house and clean all your baseboards much quicker!

Helpful Vacuum Features for Cleaning Baseboards 

Ideally, you should make an informed decision about a vacuum that won't disappoint, as a terrible vacuum can't help but be noticed. And if you're looking for something to help keep the baseboards in your home clean, consider the following features when shopping for your next vacuum.

Ease of Use

In terms of mobility, does the vacuum weigh too much to carry? It can roll and pivot without getting trapped if it has wheels. There are places like beneath the sofa or behind the furniture where it can quickly get in and out. 

A single charge should be sufficient for thorough cleaning if the vacuum is battery-powered. The cord should not get in the way of vacuuming if it has a cable. 

You should also ask yourself: 

  • Do you need to plug the vacuum in someplace else to clean a wide area? 
  • What is the handle's ergonomics? 
  • Is it a good fit for my hands? 
  • Can I vacuum without kneeling or bending over? 

Cleaning Power

The following questions should help you find a vacuum that gives positive results: 

  • How much is the vacuum capable of picking up small particles such as crumbs, dust, and pet dander? 
  • What surfaces does it work best on? 
  • Is it as effective on hardwood floors and shaggy carpets? 
  • Is it capable of deep cleaning thick rugs? 

Accessories and Special Features

Does the vacuum come with any attachments, such as a brush or upholstery nozzle? How do they function? Do they make it easier for you to clean places that you would otherwise be unable to? Does the vacuum come with rubber strips and bumpers that prevent scratches on baseboards? And, what other cleaning modes or functions does the vacuum have? 

Durability and Maintenance

The last crucial factor to consider while choosing a vacuum revolves around durability, cleaning, and maintenance. How do they function if the vacuum comes with any attachments, such as a brush or upholstery nozzle? Do they make it easier for you to clean places that you would otherwise be unable to? What other cleaning modes or functions does the vacuum have? 

Conclusion

Purchasing a vacuum cleaner is not the most exciting, as it doesn't offer you an immediate rush, unlike a new pair of clothes or a fresh mascara shade. And it can be challenging to choose a vacuum since they all promise great things. Just be sure to consider all the factors most important to you before purchasing a new vacuum, and you'll be sure to find a good one.
